name: Agentic Inventory
tagline: AI-driven polyglot microservices platform for real-time stock & forecasting intelligence.
description:
Agentic Inventory is a production-grade polyglot microservices platform engineered for real-time stock management, statistical demand forecasting, multi-database persistence, and agentic AI query processing.

Microservices Architecture:
- inventory-service (Java 17/21 & Spring Boot 3.4.1): Core transactional engine with non-blocking 2-phase reservations (reserve/claim/release), Spring Security Basic/RBAC, Kafka stock mutation events, and 5 pluggable RDBMS dialects (PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL, Oracle, DB2).
- catalog-service (Java 17/21 & MongoDB 6.0): Dynamic document-based product management for technical specs, categories, and seeder pipelines.
- forecasting-service (Python 3.11 & FastAPI): Scikit-Learn trained ML intent classifier (1,700+ queries across 15 intents), NER entity extraction, dual-mode Gemini/OpenAI router with offline local ML fallback, and statistical demand forecasting.
- Key Capabilities: Non-blocking reservation backend, cross-service correlation tracing (X-Correlation-ID), safety stock Z-formulas (Z=1.65, 95% service level), interactive Markdown chat workspace (/chat.html), multi-format export (XLSX/DOCX/PDF), rootless Podman/Docker Compose configs, and Helm charts.
